children.description: Based on 4 whole­mount preparations of 3 worms and fragments of a fourth (remainder of specimen reserved for molecular studies). Measurements and ratios in Table 1. Body elongate, narrow, wider at oral and ventral suckers and in region of gonads (Figure 1). Tegument spinous, unarmed patch immediately posterior to oral sucker, large spines densely packed in forebody, smaller in hindbody, sparser in hindbody, few seen posteriorly to testes. Oral sucker terminal, wider than long. Circum­oral spines in double ring, with distinct ventral hiatus, spines decrease in size markedly towards hiatus (Figure 2). Ventral sucker oval, in anterior fifth of body. Prepharynx long. Pharynx pyriform. Oesophagus distinct. Intestinal bifurcation in posterior forebody. Caeca long, narrow, posterior caecal extremities obscured by vitelline follicles in 2 specimens, in 1 specimen lateral wall of caecal terminations abut and appear to merge with wall of excretory vesicle, luminal connection forming uroproct not confirmed.
